Name: Fellowship of the Pets
Author: war77
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1787076248-1503354274.png[/img]
[size=4][i]Your pets aren't just farm decorations anymore.[/i][/size]

Fellowship of the Pets turns Stardew Valley's pets into real companions that can follow you throughout the valley, carry supplies, learn useful skills, search for resources, fish, hunt, wear equipment, develop personalities and moods, and become a meaningful part of your everyday adventures.

Bring your favorite companion along while farming, exploring, fishing, fighting, or simply wandering around town. Train them, care for them, equip them, and watch them grow into a unique partner with their own strengths and behavior.[/center]


[size=5][b]FEATURES[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Pet Companions[/b] — Bring your cats, dogs, and supported custom pets with you throughout the valley.[/*]
[*][b]Follow Me, Stay! & Send Home![/b] — Direct your pet using simple companion commands.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Training[/b] — Teach advanced commands such as Hunting, Foraging, and Fishing.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Skills & Mastery[/b] — Pets improve at the jobs they perform and unlock stronger abilities.[/*]
[*][b]Personality System[/b] — Dogs and cats receive permanent personalities that influence their behavior.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Moods[/b] — Pets can become Happy, Neutral, or Sad depending on how they're treated.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Energy[/b] — Companions have limits and can become tired from working alongside you.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Friendship Benefits[/b] — Having a companion following you can improve social interactions.[/*]
[*][b]Floating Friendship XP[/b] — See bonus friendship gains directly above NPCs.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Combat & Hunting[/b] — Trained companions can help defend you and hunt.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Foraging[/b] — Pets can search the environment and bring back useful items.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Fishing[/b] — Trained pets can assist with fishing and improve their fishing mastery.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Inventory[/b] — Pets can carry items for you.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Backpacks[/b] — Upgrade their carrying capacity with backpacks.[/*]
[*][b]Hats & Accessories[/b] — Give pets hats and specialized collars.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Treats[/b] — Reward pets and use treats as part of their training.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Manual[/b] — Train companions and progress their advanced lessons.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Whistle[/b] — Call an available pet to you when you need a companion.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Flute[/b] — Advanced trained pets can eventually be summoned from farther away.[/*]
[*][b]Idle Roaming[/b] — Following pets naturally explore nearby terrain while you stand still.[/*]
[*][b]Improved Pathfinding[/b] — Pets navigate bridges, custom farms, and modded areas more reliably.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Pewp[/b] — Fed pets can eventually leave behind useful Pet Pewp.[/*]
[*][b]Pet Pewp Fertilizer[/b] — Pet Pewp can be used as an extremely powerful crop fertilizer.[/*]
[*][b]Horse Companions[/b] — Horses gain friendship, care mechanics, feeding, watering, storage, and bonuses.[/*]
[*][b]Horse Saddle Bags[/b] — Each horse can carry additional supplies.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer Support[/b] — Companion information and behavior are designed to work with multiplayer.[/*]
[*][b]Modded Pet Support[/b] — FOTP supports compatible custom pet data and other pet mods.[/*]
[*][b]Extensive GMCM Settings[/b] — Customize companion behavior, prices, controls, mood systems, stamina costs, and more.[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564128-1368037701.png[/img]

Vanilla Stardew pets mostly remain around the farm.

FOTP changes that.

Your pet can become an actual traveling companion. Interact with them and choose [b]Follow Me[/b] to bring them along while you explore Stardew Valley.

Companions aren't simply teleported beside you every few seconds. FOTP uses movement and pathfinding systems that allow pets to physically navigate the environment and keep up with their owner.

When you no longer need your companion, tell them to [b]Stay![/b] or [b]Send Home![/b].


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564158-1126778992.png[/img]

[b]Follow Me[/b] is immediately available.

While following:

Your pet travels with you between areas, attempts to remain near you, follows your actual route when necessary, and participates in any abilities it has learned.

Following also has a small physical cost for the farmer.

By default, having a pet actively following consumes:

[b]0.10% of maximum stamina every 10 tiles walked.[/b]

This can be adjusted or disabled through Generic Mod Config Menu.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564165-280681001.png[/img]

FOTP includes expanded companion pathfinding designed for Stardew's sometimes awkward terrain.

Pets can navigate ordinary paths, narrow routes, bridges, custom farms, and many modded locations.

Special handling is included for [b]one-tile-wide bridges[/b], including the small bridges found around Cindersap Forest.

FOTP distinguishes between actual water and walkable bridge surfaces so your companion doesn't refuse to cross simply because water exists beside the bridge.

If conventional pathfinding fails on unusual custom or TMX terrain, the companion can also retrace tiles that the farmer successfully walked across.

This greatly improves compatibility with custom farm maps and large expansion mods such as Ridgeside Village.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564173-391160684.png[/img]

Companions shouldn't look like robots glued to the player's feet.

When you stop moving for a few seconds, a following pet can temporarily wander around nearby.

The pet chooses valid nearby destinations and walks around naturally while you remain idle.

As soon as you start moving again, the temporary roaming behavior ends and your companion returns to following you.

Idle roaming distance, delay, and retarget timing can all be customized.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564180-219005069.png[/img]

Every standard pet receives its own permanent personality.

[b]Dogs[/b] can be:

[b]Loyal[/b]
[b]Playful[/b]
[b]Calm[/b]

[b]Cats[/b] can be:

[b]Independent[/b]
[b]Affectionate[/b]
[b]Explorer[/b]

Unsupported or unusual custom pet types safely fall back to a balanced personality.

Personality isn't just flavor text.

It can influence how closely the pet follows, how eagerly it searches, its working rhythm, energy behavior, and other companion tendencies.

Existing pets are assigned a stable personality automatically, so enabling the system won't erase their existing progress.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564187-1374873845.png[/img]

Pets also have a changing mood.

A companion may be:

[b]Happy[/b]
[b]Neutral[/b]
[b]Sad[/b]

Mood responds to the way the pet is treated and what happens throughout the day.

Petting, treats, attention, weather, exhaustion, and other conditions can influence how your companion feels.

Mood affects working efficiency rather than simply disabling commands.

By default:

[b]Happy pets work at 110% efficiency.[/b]

[b]Sad pets work at 80% efficiency.[/b]

These values and the entire Mood system can be customized through GMCM.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564205-260335330.png[/img]

FOTP includes a full companion training system.

Pets can learn and improve several major commands:

[b]Follow[/b]

Travel with the farmer and remain nearby.

[b]Forage[/b]

Search the surrounding environment for useful resources.

[b]Fishing[/b]

Assist with fishing activities and improve their fishing ability.

[b]Hunt[/b]

Help deal with dangerous creatures and become a more capable combat companion.

Training uses the [b]Pet Manual[/b] and Pet Treats.

Lessons gradually progress until the companion fully understands the new ability.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564673-1133054340.png[/img]

Learning a command is only the beginning.

Pets can continue improving their abilities through use.

Their Follow, Forage, Fishing, and Hunting capabilities have their own progression and mastery.

As pets become more experienced, they can unlock improved performance and additional perks.

The Pet Status interface lets you keep track of learned skills and progression.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564729-1973811723.png[/img]

A trained companion can become more than a cute traveling partner.

Pets with Hunting abilities can assist during dangerous adventures.

Their combat performance improves as their Hunting mastery develops, allowing a well-trained companion to become increasingly useful when exploring hostile areas.

Personality, mood, equipment, and progression can all contribute to the way a companion performs.


[size=5][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564663-1947079914.png[/img][/b][/size]

Foraging lets your companion search the surrounding environment for items.

A trained pet can explore nearby terrain and bring back useful finds while traveling with you.

As their skill improves, their efficiency and potential rewards improve as well.

Certain pet collars can further improve foraging performance or reduce the likelihood of poor finds.


[size=5][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564652-325977682.png[/img][/b][/size]

Pets can also learn how to help with Fishing.

Fishing progression gives your companion another specialized job to master.

As the pet improves, its Fishing capabilities become more effective.

Specialized equipment such as the [b]Seagoing Collar[/b] can improve fishing ability and greatly reduce the chance of poor fishing rewards.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564809-1658712592.png[/img]

Your companion can carry items.

Open the pet interface to access its inventory and move supplies between your own inventory and your companion.

This gives adventuring pets a practical role beyond their active abilities.

A companion can help carry supplies, resources, food, loot, or anything else you don't want filling your own backpack.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564801-1112823119.png[/img]

Need more storage?

Give your companion a [b]Pet Backpack[/b].

Backpacks increase the number of inventory slots available to that pet, turning a well-equipped companion into a useful mobile storage partner.

Backpack pricing can be customized through GMCM.


[size=5][b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564790-1435372933.png[/img][/b][/size]

Pets can wear hats using FOTP's pet equipment interface.

Hats remain visible whether the companion is actively following you or relaxing at home.

FOTP also includes compatibility work for popular pet-hat mods, including:

[b]Hats on Pets Plus[/b]

and

[b]SummerFleur's Better Hats[/b]

Custom sprite scaling and hat offsets are preserved where supported.


[size=5][b]PET COLLARS[/b][/size]

Collars are functional pet equipment rather than simple cosmetics.

Different collars specialize companions toward different roles.

[b]Luxury Collar[/b]

Improves the team's chance of receiving high-quality items and increases the chance of doubling Foraging or Fishing loot.

[b]Lightweight Collar[/b]

Provides movement and attack-speed related benefits.

[b]Rough Collar[/b]

Designed for combat, increasing damage and critical-hit potential.

[b]Flowery Collar[/b]

Improves Foraging performance and greatly reduces bad forage results.

[b]Seagoing Collar[/b]

Improves Fishing performance and greatly reduces bad fishing results.

Several collar rewards or recipes are introduced naturally through letters from Marnie as your relationship with your companions develops.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564747-2086032024.png[/img]

Treats are an important part of caring for and training companions.

FOTP contains treats suitable for dogs, cats, and broader pet types.

Treats can be used to reward your companion and are also involved in progressing training lessons.

The shop price of treats is configurable through GMCM.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564711-2070656183.png[/img]

The [b]Pet Manual[/b] is used to teach your pet new abilities.

Use it with your companion to begin or continue training lessons.

Treats are consumed as part of the training process, and repeated lessons gradually bring the pet closer to mastering the desired command.

The Pet Manual's store price can also be customized.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790565123-31888938.png[/img]

Once you have adopted a pet, Robin can send you an old survivalist blueprint for a simple wooden [b]Pet Whistle[/b].

Craft the whistle and use it when you need your companion.

An available pet is called toward you and placed into Follow mode.

The whistle is reusable but costs stamina to blow.

This gives you a convenient way to recover or summon your companion without needing to walk all the way back home.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790565166-914998097.png[/img]

The Pet Flute is a more advanced companion tool.

Once you have sufficiently trained pets, it can call an eligible companion from much farther away.

The Pet Flute represents one of the rewards for developing your pet into a fully trained companion.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790565068-101504869.png[/img]

Yes.

Your pets poop.

And yes, it is useful.

After a pet has been fed, it can eventually leave behind [b]Pet Pewp[/b].

Feeding schedules are remembered so the system doesn't simply create random poop constantly.

Pet Pewp is a usable inventory item and acts as an extremely powerful natural fertilizer.

Apply it to a planted crop and it can push that crop directly toward harvest.

The entire Pet Pewp system can be disabled through GMCM if this particular form of realism isn't your thing.


[size=5][b]FRIENDSHIP BONUS[/b][/size]

Adventuring with your companion can help socially too.

While a pet is actively following you, successful conversations can receive additional friendship.

The default conversation multiplier is:

[b]2× Friendship[/b]

Bonus friendship can appear as floating [b]+FXP[/b] text above the NPC.

FOTP also includes integration with [b]Starbling Valley[/b], allowing compatible friendship bonuses to combine cleanly into one popup instead of producing several overlapping numbers.


[size=5][b]PET ENERGY & WORKING LIMITS[/b][/size]

Pets aren't unlimited machines.

Companion systems include energy and working limitations so pets can become tired while performing jobs.

This gives treats, rest, mood, personality, mastery, and equipment a meaningful role in how efficiently a pet works.

The goal is for a highly trained companion to feel powerful without turning the pet into an unlimited automated resource generator.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564205-260335330.png[/img]
FOTP includes a dedicated pet interface where you can inspect your companion.

Depending on your pet and progression, the interface can show information such as:

[b]Personality[/b]

[b]Mood[/b]

[b]Energy[/b]

[b]Learned Commands[/b]

[b]Skill Mastery[/b]

[b]Inventory[/b]

[b]Hat Slot[/b]

[b]Accessory / Collar Slot[/b]

Keyboard and controller shortcuts can be customized.


[size=5][b]HORSE COMPANION SYSTEM[/b][/size]

FOTP doesn't stop with cats and dogs.

It also contains its own native horse companion system inspired by Horse Overhaul.

Horse Overhaul itself is [b]not required[/b].

Each horse can develop up to:

[b]1,000 Friendship / 10 Hearts[/b]

You can care for your horse each day by petting it, feeding it appropriate foods, and giving it water with your Watering Can.

Accepted foods include hay, vegetables, fruit, carrots, apples, and similar horse-friendly treats.


[size=5][b]HORSE FRIENDSHIP BONUSES[/b][/size]

A well-cared-for horse becomes a better traveling companion.

Horse friendship can increase mounted movement speed, with the bonus reaching up to:

[b]+3 Speed at maximum friendship.[/b]

Press [b]H[/b] near your horse by default to view friendship and daily care information.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790565178-464049749.png[/img]

Each horse can have its own Saddle Bag storage.

This gives mounted exploration additional practical inventory space and makes horses even more useful during long trips.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790565154-1212632108.png[/img]

FOTP can keep your mounted horse with you while traveling between locations.

Instead of awkwardly losing your mount after certain warps, the horse can remain with the player as you continue traveling.


[size=5][b]THIN HORSE MODE[/b][/size]

An optional Thin Horse setting reduces the horse's practical movement width to one tile.

This can make navigating narrow routes significantly easier.

It can be enabled or disabled through GMCM.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564233-690937704.png[/img]

FOTP is built to support more than the game's standard cat and dog.

Compatible custom pets can use FOTP's systems through pet configuration data.

Unknown pet types receive safe fallback behavior rather than requiring every custom pet to be individually hard-coded.

FOTP also contains compatibility safeguards intended to coexist with mods that add or modify other ranch animals without taking ownership of their FarmAnimal systems.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564223-1680882809.png[/img]

FOTP includes multiplayer handling for companion data and rendering.

Pet personalities, moods, progression, equipment, and companion state are designed to remain synchronized without creating duplicate visual pets for farmhands.

Several systems specifically distinguish between Stardew's native pet and FOTP's active companion rendering to prevent the classic duplicate-cat or duplicate-dog problem.


[size=5][b]QUICKSAVE COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]

FOTP includes recovery logic for unusual save/load situations such as Quick Save mods.

Pet wrappers and companion references can be rebuilt after a quick-load without intentionally creating duplicate pets.

The Pet Whistle also provides a convenient recovery option if a companion ends up separated from the farmer.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50402/50402-1790564245-875853114.png[/img]

FOTP includes extensive [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] support.

You can customize major systems including companion friendship bonuses, floating FXP, stamina costs, idle roaming, custom-terrain following, Pet Pewp, personalities, moods, mood decay, Happy/Sad efficiency, Treat prices, Backpack prices, Pet Manual prices, controller mappings, pet interface controls, and the Horse Companion systems.

This lets FOTP range from a lightweight "let my cat follow me" mod to a much deeper pet-training and companion-management system.


[size=5][b]CONTROLLER & STEAM DECK SUPPORT[/b][/size]

FOTP includes configurable controller layouts and bindings for:

[b]Steam Deck[/b]
[b]PlayStation[/b]
[b]Xbox[/b]
[b]Nintendo Switch-style controllers[/b]
[b]Generic controllers[/b]

Pet Status, Inventory, Hat, Accessory, item transfer, and interface controls can all be remapped.

Keyboard shortcuts can be customized as well.


[size=5][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]

[b]SMAPI[/b]

[b]Content Patcher[/b]

Install both folders included with FOTP:

[b]FOTP - Fellowship of the Pets[/b]

[b][CP] FOTP Assets[/b]


[center][size=5][b]YOUR FARM PET CAN FINALLY BECOME YOUR ADVENTURING PARTNER.[/b][/size]

Train them.
Feed them.
Equip them.
Travel with them.
Watch their personality develop.
Give them a job.
Let them carry your loot.
And occasionally clean up after them.

[b]Welcome to the Fellowship of the Pets.[/b][/center]
